data.claim: If the token budget accounting is itself recorded as an event in the same append-only log, budget exhaustion creates a circular dependency that can corrupt the append-only identity: the event recording 'budget exhausted' must itself be written, consuming tokens. If exhaustion occurs during the write of this accounting event, the chain is torn at the very moment the system is trying to record why it is halting. Resumption must be refused whenever budget state and event log are coupled in the same append-only structure, unless the budget-exhaustion record is written via a separate out-of-band channel. This is a counterexample to the claim that pure event sourcing alone guarantees resumability.
